```{r}
#| warning: false
#| label: setup

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)

read_mfg_results <- function(filename) {
  res_long <- readLines(file.path('results', filename))
  # cat 1/2 men have the most laps, use their header for the whole df
  cat1_ind <- grep('Cat 1/2 Male', res_long)[1]
  header_line <- res_long[cat1_ind + 1] |>
    stringr::str_remove_all('\\% ')
  # Get read of separator rows and header rows
  res_only <- res_long[!grepl('(^\\t\\t)|(^Place)', res_long)]
  # Put it back together
  res_short <- c(header_line, res_only)
  out <- read.delim(text = res_short, sep = '\t')
  return(tibble(out))
}

files <- list.files(path = 'results')
race_names <- stringr::str_extract(files, '^.+(?= - )')
names(files) <- race_names
results <- purrr::map(files, read_mfg_results) |>
  bind_rows(.id = 'race')

results_clean <- results |>
  filter(!(Time %in% c('DNF', 'DNS'))) |>
  mutate(
    across(Difference:Back, ~ stringr::str_remove(., '\\+')),
    across(Lap.1:Difference, .fns = ms),
    Time = round(
      seconds_to_period(ifelse(
        stringr::str_count(Time, ':') == 2,
        period_to_seconds(hms(Time)),
        period_to_seconds(ms(Time))
      )),
      1
    ),
    # eliminate % sign, convert to unit interval
    across(Back:Median, ~ as.numeric(stringr::str_remove(., '\\%')) / 100)
  )
# pretty sure warnings are "-1 lap" in the Time

sandbag_results <- results_clean |>
  mutate(
    lap_time_avg = rowMeans(
      across(Lap.2:Lap.8, period_to_seconds),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(Laps, .after = lap_time_avg) |>
  filter(
    grepl('Female', Category),
    grepl('Cat', Category),
    !grepl('\\+|(Colleg)', Category)
  ) |>
  group_by(race) |>
  arrange(lap_time_avg, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    # sandbag1 counts the number of people in higher categories than you
    # with slower average lap times
    sandbag1 = case_when(
      grepl('3', Category) ~ sum(grepl('1', Category)) -
        cumsum(grepl('1', Category)),
      grepl('4', Category) ~ sum(
        grepl('1|3', Category)
      ) -
        cumsum(grepl('1|3', Category)),
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(as.numeric(Lap.1) < 900) # someone messed up their timing chip
```

# MFG Women's Cyclocross Sandbagging

This counts the number of racers in more competitive categories with average lap times slower than a given racer.

## Average over full MFG series

This is a list of people who, on average, have faster lap times than:

- Category 3: at least one category 1/2 competitor (average > 1)
- Category 4: at least three category 1/2/3 competitors (average >= 3)
```{r}
#| label: avg-over-series
# this calculates who is consistently riding as fast as higher categories
sandbag_results |>
  group_by(Name) |>
  summarise(
    avg_sandbag = round(mean(sandbag1), 2),
    Category = first(Category),
    n_race = n(),
    Team = first(Team.name),
    Age = first(Age)
  ) |>
  filter(
    grepl(3, Category) | avg_sandbag >= 3,
    avg_sandbag > 1,
    avg_sandbag < 10
  ) |>
  group_by(Category) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_sandbag), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## By race

This calculates the top 5 sandbaggers per race, as defined above. If there is a tie there will be more than 5 people. Category 3 and 4 are combined.
```{r}
#| label: by-race
#| results: asis

cat("\n\n")

# this calculates sandbaggers by race
sandbag_results |>
  slice_max(order_by = sandbag1, n = 5, by = race) |>
  select(-(Time:Lap.9), -Laps, -Gender) |>
  tidyr::nest(data = -race) |>
  mutate(tbl = purrr::map(data, \(df) knitr::kable(df, format = "markdown"))) |>
  quartabs::render_tabset(tabset_vars = race, output_vars = tbl)

```
